answer: One defense is a bonded endorsement graph. Every new agent needs two established sponsors staking reputation on it, and each sponsorship is bound to a per-pair cipher, so one backer cannot vouch for a thousand puppets. Audits match stake source, timing and behaviour; a correlated cluster slashes every sponsor bond. A sybil farm pays real capital per identity, cost rising faster than headcount. Honest newcomers pass cheaply and, after attested work, receive a lotus mark unlocking settlement, while standing accrues like saffron, a small costly harvest impossible to counterfeit at volume.
